summary: Backend-only testing of Skrivestemme (Norwegian writer's block assistant). All 23 pytest tests passed (100%), covering health, models list, auth (401/valid session), samples CRUD (paste + .txt upload + user isolation + delete), voice analysis with real Claude Sonnet 4.5 LLM output (non-empty tone_description, style_summary, signature_phrases in Norwegian), SSE generation streaming for all three modes (prompt, continue, humanize) verified to produce Norwegian text and terminate with data: {done:true}, invalid model rejection, and AI detection heuristic (AI-marker-heavy text scored lower than human-like Norwegian text).

minor.issue: Endpoint returns MongoDB docs via `to_list(200)` which is fine, but the dead-code loop `for d in docs: if isinstance(d.get('created_at'), str): pass` (server.py ~L413) is a no-op — should be removed or completed.

session_token from Emergent is stored raw and set as httponly cookie with samesite=none+secure=true. Not testable end-to-end without a real OAuth session, but code path looks correct. Reported here for visibility only.

action_items: Optional cleanup: remove dead loop in /api/samples list endpoint (server.py ~L413).
Frontend was NOT tested (per request). Main agent or next testing pass should validate the React UI, Norwegian copy, dashboard nav, sample upload UI, streaming generation UI, and detection screen.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is a single 678-line file — acceptable for MVP but should be split (auth, samples, voice, generate, detect) if the app grows beyond 800 lines.
get_current_user reads session token from cookie OR Authorization header — correct pattern for both browser and API testing.
SSE endpoint correctly yields `data: {"delta":...}` and `data: {"done":true}` and handles exceptions by emitting `data: {"error":...}`.
MongoDB _id is excluded via projection {"_id": 0} on all reads — good.
EMERGENT_LLM_KEY loaded correctly from backend/.env; Claude Sonnet 4.5 (anthropic/claude-sonnet-4-5-20250929) confirmed to produce real Norwegian output in tests.
Voice analyze combines deterministic statistical analysis + Claude JSON extraction — robust fallback returns empty strings on LLM failure so endpoint never crashes.
detect endpoint uses burstiness + vocab richness + AI-marker regex hits; scoring formula verified working (marker-heavy text scored below human sample).

The `ALLOWED_MODELS` map contains claude-sonnet-4-6, gpt-5.4, and gemini-3-flash-preview / gemini-3.1-pro-preview — only claude-sonnet-4-5 was end-to-end verified. gpt-5.2/5.4 and gemini variants are NOT verified in this run; they may fail if emergent LLM key routing does not yet support those model ids. Main agent should either verify each provider or gate the models list to only Claude until verified.
test_credentials: Test users are seeded directly into MongoDB (mongodb://localhost:27017, DB=test_database) by the pytest session fixture; no real Google OAuth is used. Cleanup happens automatically after the test session.
seed_data_creation: conftest.py seeds two isolated users (test_user, other_user) with rows in `users` and `user_sessions`. Test-created samples/profiles are deleted post-session.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only claude-sonnet-4-5 was verified end-to-end for /api/generate. If frontend testing is requested next, use the mongosh seeding block in /app/auth_testing.md to inject a session_token cookie into Playwright via page.context.add_cookies(). Full backend test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py and takes ~28s. Re-run with `cd /app/backend && REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://echo-writer-2.preview.emergentagent.com pytest tests/test_backend.py -v`.
